'''Norjax Thall''' was a professional [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]]. He was a member of the [[Flamestrike Legion]] until the unit was forcibly disbanded by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He joined other [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] groups but grew disaffected with the nature of the conflicts. He had a stint working security for the [[New Cov Biomolecule Company]] but left to work security for an organized crime group. He found that he enjoyed the experience, challenge, and credits that came with the job. Thall was sent to neutralize a [[Syndicate One]] but the groups involved managed to resolve the situation. However, [[Saujutta-Ok-Topii]] was impressed with the soldier's abilities and Thall was recruited into the criminal organization. He served as a tactics and weapons expert.
